 China's Chery to recall 53,882 cars over rear-axle welding defect
 Published : Nov. 6, 2026 - 19:41:14
 Add The Korea Herald on Google
 Link copied!
 Chery’s Omoda brand is displayed at the company’s booth during the Beijing International Automotive Exhibition in Beijing, on April 24. (Reuters-Yonhap) Chery will recall 53,882 ‌vehicles starting later this month over ‌a manufacturing defect in the rear axle, China's ⁠market regulator said on Friday.
 The recall, covering Tiggo 5x ⁠and Omoda models produced between ​June 2022 and December 2023, ‌stems from a ‌rear-axle welding ‌defect that could, ‌in extreme ​cases, lead to ⁠loss of wheel control and increase crash risks, ⁠according ​to ⁠a company filing with the market ​regulator.
 Chery's Chair Yin Tongyue has publicly ⁠apologised over quality ⁠issues ⁠following ‌a rear axle detachment involving its Omoda ​model in Malaysia. (Reuters-Yonhap)
